1936, June
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 119 Cont.
June 20 Ron Thomas - very peculiar tuomer on hip bone. Blood cancer feared. Enrolled To-day (50c) when very little hope is left.
Francis Ploukey - 63 - nose-bleed for two weeks. . Enrolled To-day 50¢
19
Matthew Gallaher - 54 - Hopeless cancer of stomach in St. Joseph's
21st Hospital. Comes To-day on way home. Has hope at health.
Joseph Kreucher - 41 - infection in ha'd and leg now about four weeks.
Mrs. James Carkery - 40 of Ottawa Co. - nerv.
Mrs. Frances Radziolowski - T.B. and diabetis - mother of Sr. Columbane.
Peter F. Connally - 35 - Sleeping - sickness 13 yrs. Studied for holy priest-hood for 3 yrs.
H. Dan. Small - 63 - Baptist .... Mrs. Formiller .... Husband is N. Cat.
Page 120 June 24 Eleanor Strasburg - 41 - Luthern -- lost breast by cancer - and voice ... improving since Sunday .... Enrolled that day.
Page 121
1936, July
July 1 Stanley Wludyke - 28 - acute nefritis 5 months. - has wife and one little ch.
Mrs. Van Winkle
Rose Nowicki - 41 - disconsolate on account of eight-yr .- old daugh- ter. The little one received First Holy Comm. on Wednesday on death bed - died following Sunday. Seemed to act as receiving every little while after.
Hector Trif - 52 - fell off ladder and broke his leg ....
Sylvia Grossman - 19 - keeping undesirable company ... "absolutely lazy" Enrolled To-day 50c promising 5.00
